In the beginning of Creation, Ptah made the Dragons as a gift to his wife, Eris. She delighted in their beautiful colors, glimmering scales, and awesome forms. Eris, for her own reasons, imbued the Dragons with Godlike powers and gave them human flaws. The Dragons, naturally, ruled Creation as Demigods for a time. They shepherded the Mortals, tended to them, used them, shaped them, and occasionally, ate them. The Dragons taught the Mortals about life, character, and the capricious nature of the Gods. At the end of their time, the Dragons were mysteriously evicted from the Material Plane when Brelas Wyrmbane climbed to the top of the Dragonbacks and slew Faldbar Goldfang, the most fearsome of the Dragons, with a magical blade. Since then, none have been seen in the world, though those who travel the planes report that they live on in the outer realms.
